result.question: Quais são os 5 municípios com maior percentual de internações em UTI (com mais de 5000 internações)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS municipio, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" GROUP BY mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ORDER BY pct_uti DESC LIMIT 5;
result.generated_sql: WITH total_internacoes AS ( SELECT "MUNIC_RES", COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ), uti_internacoes AS ( SELECT "MUNIC_RES", COUNT(*) AS total_uti FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES" ) SELECT mu."NO_MUNICIPIO", ROUND(COALESCE(100.0 * ui.total_uti / ti.total, 0), 2) AS taxa_uti FROM total_internacoes ti JOIN uti_internacoes ui ON ti."MUNIC_RES" = ui."MUNIC_RES" JOIN municipios mu ON ti."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" ORDER BY taxa_uti DESC LIMIT 5;
